title: Build longitudinal roster and verified-reference research profiles
summary: Prepare immutable per-person and anonymous reference profiles across recurring meetings, respecting historical identity verification, recording groups, speaking mode and roster/role changes. Reuse the behavior module; do not update production enrollment banks or treat the recurring roster as a closed identity universe.
in_scope: Copied verified-reference and anonymous profile views
out_of_scope: Automatic enrollment from roster membership or a recognition cue
Treating source-model identities as human ground truth
implementation: Import copied enrollment/verification snapshots with explicit source IDs and verification/link-availability timestamps; absent history forces retrospective or anonymous-only use.
Build profile manifests through existing pure behavior extraction/aggregation interfaces, preserving original source spans and separating prepared, spontaneous and unknown mode.
Record roster, attendance and chair/member/staff/witness role intervals as distinct contextual evidence with known/unknown scope; include guest, substitute and never-enrolled speakers.
Report raw samples/turns/hearings and independent provenance-group counts for every feature family and reference gap; control long meetings and repeated sources through group balancing.
Freeze profile digests and training cutoff for each experimental run; retain predecessor/revocation references without recomputing old run inputs from live DIAT state.

acceptance.criterion: No reference can enter a strict historical profile before its evidence and verified identity link were available.
acceptance.verification: Test future/missing verification/link clocks and assert explicit exclusion or mode refusal.

acceptance.criterion: Prepared/spontaneous/unknown modes and independent source groups retain their current separation.
acceptance.verification: Compare pure-profile outputs against existing behavior fixtures and new copied-reference manifests.

acceptance.criterion: Guest or unknown speakers remain eligible query cases without being forced into the reported recurring roster.
acceptance.verification: Run fixed-candidate/anonymous tests with roster turnover and an unenrolled participant.

acceptance.criterion: Repeated references and long meetings do not silently dominate profile evidence.
acceptance.verification: Use one duplicated hearing group and one independent group with unequal turn counts; verify coverage and declared weighting.

tests: Identity verified only after the query meeting
Same person changes from chair to ordinary member
Prepared scripts repeated by two speakers
Transitive recording alias through an unenrolled source
risks: Small recurring rosters can conceal open-set errors.
Historical active-enrollment state may not be reconstructable from current snapshots.

reuse.application: Reuse mode separation, group-balanced aggregation and exclusion before comparison.
Reuse identity-link timestamps and frozen profile digest semantics.

sources: User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
